description_en: Applies for coordination monitoring. This operation is mainly used in administrator assistance scenarios and education scenarios
description_zh: 管理员向终端用户发起远程协助请求。主要用于管理员协助场景和教育场景
kebab_example: aliyun ecd apply-coordination-for-monitoring --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --uuid 3E14A18BD4D088504B9F8A8751AB0000 --initiator-type ADMIN_INITIATE --coordinate-policy-type FULL_CONTROL --resource-candidates OwnerEndUserId=alice ResourceRegionId=cn-hangzhou ResourceId=ecd-08zhejm3h7ilr0000 ResourceName=DemoComputer ResourceType=CLOUD_DESKTOP ResourceProperties=TestProperty OwnerAliUid=1302470215170000 --end-user-id alice --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApplyCoordinationForMonitoring

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/ecd/2020-09-30/DescribeRegions) operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The universally unique identifier (UUID) of the device
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the initiator.

Set the value to ADMIN\_INITIATE.

- The value ADMIN\_INITIATE specifies that the administrator initiates the coordination request.

  <!-- -->

  <!-- -->

  <!-- -->
parameters.name: initiator_type

parameters.help_en:
The coordination policy.

Set the value to FULL\_CONTROL.

- The value FULL\_CONTROL specifies that the cloud desktop is shared and remote access to the cloud desktop is allowed.

  <!-- -->

  <!-- -->

  <!-- -->
parameters.help_zh: 远程协助过程中的权限策略
parameters.name: coordinate_policy_type

element_fields.help_en:
The resource type.

Set the value to CLOUD\_DESKTOP.

- The value CLOUD\_DESKTOP specifies that the resource is a cloud desktop.

  <!-- -->

  <!-- -->

element_fields.name: resource_region_id

element_fields.name: resource_properties
